name: okl
description: Observed Knowledge Ledger: lessons your coding agents can trust. A pre-task briefing hook, an end-of-session 'what did we learn?' hook, the okl MCP tools, the /record and seeding commands, and the encoding-loop skill. Needs the okl CLI (pipx install 'observed-knowledge-ledger[mcp]'), and `okl init` in each repo to brief (or OKL_SERVICE_URL); repos without it are left alone.
